prompt: A colossal cresting tidal wave of deep cerulean and sapphire water, foaming white at the crest, towering over a battlefield and crashing down on a line of armored soldiers, sweeping them up and tumbling them backward inside the churning water. The soldiers flail, lifted off their feet, carried away by the surge. The background is a dark stormy sky over a flooded plain. The only bright light is the foaming white spray of the wave.

Worms-eye view from a fallen armored soldier looking up as an enormous wall of dark blue seawater curls overhead, about to crash down. The soldier in the foreground throws up one gauntleted arm in terror, his shield slipping from his grip. Above him the wave is a towering green-blue curl streaked with white foam, blotting out the sky. The background is the underside of the breaking wave, churning and translucent.

The hollow barrel of a giant breaking wave, a curling tube of translucent emerald and cerulean seawater. Caught inside the spinning curl are several small armored figures and a riderless horse, tumbling helplessly, swept off the land and into the water. White foam spirals along the lip of the wave. The background is the dim interior of the wave, light filtering through the water from above.

A vast wall of cerulean water rises like a hand made of sea, its crest curling forward into clawing white-foam fingers that pluck tiny armored knights off a green hilltop and drag them into the surge. The knights are scattered and falling, dwarfed by the towering water. The background is a bruised purple-grey storm sky. Bright white foam edges the crest of the wave.

Side profile of a towering tsunami wave sweeping left to right across a flooded battlefield. In the foreground, three armored soldiers are mid-air, swept up and flung backward by the leading edge of dark blue water, weapons and a banner flying loose. The wave crest is streaked with churning white foam. The background is a low grey horizon and a flooded plain dotted with the tips of submerged tents.

A towering dark-blue tsunami wave rises on the right side of the frame, its crest curling left and streaked with white foam. On the left, four small armored soldiers are caught in the leading surge, tumbling and flung backward through the air, their weapons and a torn banner flying loose. The soldiers are clearly visible, scattered across the lower-left, swept off their feet. The background is a pale grey storm sky and a flooded grey plain.

An enormous curling tube of translucent cerulean and teal seawater fills the frame, its lip foaming white. Inside the spinning barrel of the wave, two armored knights and a horse are caught and tumbling, lifted off the ground and swept helplessly into the curl. The knights are clearly visible silhouettes against the bright water. The background is the glowing translucent inner wall of the wave with light filtering through from above.

Low-angle view across a battlefield as a vast dark cerulean wave surges in from the horizon, already knee-deep across the field. In the foreground an armored soldier is mid-fall, swept off his feet and tumbling toward the viewer in the rushing water, his sword spinning loose. Behind him two more soldiers are being carried away by the flood. The wave crest looms tall in the background, capped with white foam under a bruised storm sky.
